name: tap-notification-lambdas
description: Lambda functions for TAP notification system (API Gateway版本)

scripts.package: npm run package:aws && npm run package:tencent
scripts.package:aws: npm run package:aws-ws && npm run package:aws-webhook && npm run package:aws-trigger
scripts.package:aws-ws: npm run package:aws-ws-connect && npm run package:aws-ws-disconnect && npm run package:aws-ws-default
scripts.package:tencent: npm run package:tencent-ws && npm run package:tencent-webhook && npm run package:tencent-trigger
scripts.package:tencent-ws: npm run package:tencent-ws-register && npm run package:tencent-ws-cleanup
